hooks.command: [ "$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null)" != "main" ] || { echo '{"block": true, "message": "⛔ No editar directamente en main. Crea una feature branch: git checkout -b feature/nombre"}' >&2; exit 2; }

FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$FILE" == *.ts || "$FILE" == *.html || "$FILE" == *.scss ]]; then npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null && echo '{"feedback": "✅ Prettier aplicado en '"$FILE"'"}'; fi

FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$FILE" == *.ts ]]; then npx tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.json 2>&1 | head -20 && echo '{"feedback": "✅ TypeScript OK"}' || echo '{"feedback": "⚠️ Errores TypeScript detectados — revisar antes de commit"}'; fi
echo '🎯 Sesión Claude completada. Recuerda: pnpm lint && pnpm build antes del commit.'
